retain control: Even after selling half of the company, the founder managed to retain control of all important decisions.
即使賣掉了公司一半股份，創辦人仍設法保有所有重要決策的控制權。
retain information: Taking notes by hand helps students retain information longer than just listening to the teacher.
手寫筆記比只聽老師講課更能幫助學生記住資訊。
retain customers: Good service is the best way for a small shop to retain customers who might otherwise shop online.
良好的服務是小店留住顧客的最佳方式，否則他們可能會改上網購物。
retain the title: The tennis player trained hard all year and was able to retain the title she won last summer.
那位網球選手整年努力訓練，成功衛冕她去年夏天贏得的冠軍。
retain heat: Wool clothes retain heat well, so they keep you warm during long winter hikes in the mountains.
羊毛衣物很能保溫，所以在冬天的長途登山健行中能讓你保持溫暖。
retain a lawyer: When the company sued him, he decided to retain a lawyer to protect his rights in court.
當公司控告他時，他決定聘請律師在法庭上保護自己的權利。
retire from politics: After thirty years as a lawmaker, he announced at seventy that he would retire from politics and enjoy his grandchildren.
擔任立委三十年後，他在七十歲時宣布將退出政壇，享受陪伴孫子的時光。
retire to bed: Grandpa usually retires to bed at nine o'clock because he likes to wake up before sunrise.
爺爺通常九點就寢，因為他喜歡在日出前起床。
retire early: My aunt saved money carefully for years so that she could retire early at fifty and travel the world.
我阿姨多年來仔細存錢，好讓她能在五十歲提早退休去環遊世界。
retire a jersey number: To honor the star player, the team decided to retire his jersey number so no one else could ever wear it.
為了紀念這位明星球員，球隊決定讓他的球衣號碼退休，從此沒有人能再穿。
retire from the race: The runner hurt her ankle halfway and had to retire from the race before reaching the finish line.
那名跑者在半途扭傷腳踝，在抵達終點前不得不退出比賽。
retreat from one's position: Under strong public pressure, the minister was forced to retreat from his position on the new tax.
在強大的輿論壓力下，部長被迫在新稅制上從立場退縮。
retreat into oneself: After his best friend moved away, the shy boy began to retreat into himself and rarely talked to anyone.
最好的朋友搬走後，那個害羞的男孩開始封閉自我，很少和任何人說話。
the army retreated: Facing a much larger enemy force, the army retreated to the mountains to wait for help.
面對規模大得多的敵軍，軍隊撤退到山區等待救援。
beat a retreat: When the angry dog started barking and running toward us, we quickly beat a retreat back to the car.
當那隻兇狗開始吠叫並朝我們衝過來時，我們趕緊撤退回車上。
a weekend retreat: Our company organized a weekend retreat in the mountains so that workers could relax and get to know each other.
我們公司在山上舉辦了週末靜修活動，讓員工能放鬆並彼此認識。
return a favor: You helped me move last month, so let me return a favor by cooking you dinner tonight.
你上個月幫我搬家，所以讓我今晚煮晚餐給你吃來回報人情。
return fire: When the enemy soldiers started shooting, our troops quickly took cover and began to return fire.
當敵軍開始射擊時，我軍迅速找掩護並開始還擊。
return a call: The manager was too busy to answer the phone, but she promised to return a call to every customer before five.
經理忙得無法接電話，但她承諾五點前會回電給每一位顧客。
return a verdict: After three days of discussion, the jury is expected to return a verdict of not guilty this afternoon.
經過三天的討論，陪審團預計今天下午宣判無罪。
return to power: The former president hopes to return to power in the next election after four years out of office.
前總統在卸任四年後，希望在下次選舉中重新掌權。
return to normal: After the typhoon passes, it may take a week for life in the city to return to normal.
颱風過後，城市生活可能要花一週才能恢復正常。
in return for: My classmate helped me with math, and in return for her help, I taught her how to play the guitar.
我同學教我數學，作為回報她的幫忙，我教她彈吉他。
reveal a secret: My little sister can never keep quiet, so she revealed a secret I had told her to all her friends.
我妹妹總是守不住嘴，所以她向所有朋友揭露了我告訴她的秘密。
reveal the truth: The reporter's article finally revealed the truth about the company's dangerous chemicals, shocking the public.
那位記者的報導終於揭示了公司危險化學物質的真相，震驚社會大眾。
reveal one's identity: At the end of the movie, the masked hero takes off his mask and reveals his identity to the girl he loves.
電影最後，蒙面英雄摘下面具，向他心愛的女孩透露身分。
reveal a pattern: Studying five years of sales data revealed a pattern: people buy more ice cream on hot weekends.
研究五年的銷售數據後顯示出一個模式：人們在炎熱的週末會買更多冰淇淋。
reveal one's feelings: He is a shy person who seldom wants to reveal his feelings, so we were surprised when he cried at graduation.
他是個害羞的人，很少願意流露感情，所以他在畢業典禮上哭了讓我們很驚訝。
revealing dress: Her mother said the revealing dress was not suitable for a school dance and asked her to wear something longer.
她媽媽說那件暴露的衣服不適合學校舞會，要她穿長一點的衣服。
